issues.description: setIsMounted is not defined - hydration errors flooding the console. This indicates a useState hook for isMounted was removed or never declared but is still being called.
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/design/step-6/page.tsx, setIsMounted is called (likely in a useEffect) but the corresponding useState declaration `const [isMounted, setIsMounted] = useState(false)` is missing.

issues.description: Multiple React hydration errors: 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' causing entire root to switch to client rendering. Related to missing isMounted state causing conditional rendering to differ between server and client.
issues.root_cause: Without the isMounted state properly declared, components that conditionally render based on isMounted produce mismatched HTML between SSR and client.

issues.description: Step counter shows 'STEP 4 OF 4' but the URL is /design/step-6, suggesting the step counter in the header is hardcoded or incorrectly set for this page.
issues.root_cause: The step number displayed (4 OF 4) does not match that this is step-6. The page likely passes incorrect step props to the header/navbar component.
